allow.heading: Weekly Critique Notes
allow.reason: Design sample-data row (a read starred email in the mock list). The /starred list section is implemented and renders starred threads dynamically from the per-user demo seed; the e2e seeding contract (e2e/seeding.spec.ts) pins the seeded starred count at exactly 1 and inbox at 5, so adding this design sample as a second starred seed row would break the suite. The list renders whatever the mailbox actually contains.
